question.text: When did the dedicated Social Stock Exchange (SSE) wings of NSE and BSE formally launch in India?

answer.text: January 2018, following the Union Budget 2019-20 announcement
March 2020, during the SEBI framework revamp post-COVID
September 2022, with NSE-SSE and BSE-SSE established as segments of existing exchanges

explanation.text: **The Logic:** The NSE-SSE and BSE-SSE launched in September 2022 as dedicated segments of NSE and BSE for fundraising by Social Enterprises. The SSE framework had been approved by SEBI in July 2022 following the Technical Group Report (2020). **The Trap:** Option A conflates the Budget 2019-20 mention with launch. Option B is wrong — SSE wasn't launched in March 2020. Option D confuses later amendments with original launch. **Cross-Exam Context:** Cross-links to XII (Securities Markets) and Ch 2 (SSE Introduction & Instruments). SIAs empanelled after Sep 2022 may engage SSE-registered entities. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Note the two-tier process: SE registration on SSE, then issuance (e.g., ZCZP bond, equity, MF-for-SSE units). Your SAS scope differs based on instrument; align the engagement letter with the specific instrument in play.
